summary.ja: Suzaniは大きなロゼットと巻き茎、Otomiは動物・鳥・植物の塗りつぶしシルエットが主役です。
summary.en: Suzani centers on large rosettes and scrolling stems; Otomi centers on filled animal, bird, and plant silhouettes.

decisive_cue.ja: Suzaniは大きなロゼットと巻き茎を確認。
decisive_cue.en: Suzani centers on large rosettes and scrolling stems; Otomi centers on filled animal, bird, and plant silhouettes.

summary.ja: Kenteは細幅の織り帯を接ぐ構造、Kubaはラフィア地の角張った刺繍・アップリケが手掛かりです。
summary.en: Kente shows joined narrow woven strips; Kuba shows angular embroidery/applique on raffia.

decisive_cue.ja: Kenteは細幅の織り帯を接ぐ構造を確認。
decisive_cue.en: Kente shows joined narrow woven strips; Kuba shows angular embroidery/applique on raffia.

summary.ja: Bogolanは黒〜茶の泥染め記号、Adireは藍地の白い防染が中心です。
summary.en: Bogolan uses dark mud-dyed geometry; Adire uses pale resisted marks on indigo.

decisive_cue.ja: Bogolanは黒〜茶の泥染め記号を確認。
decisive_cue.en: Bogolan uses dark mud-dyed geometry; Adire uses pale resisted marks on indigo.

summary.ja: Adireは藍染めの多様な防染語彙、Tie-dyeは縛り点から放射する輪やにじみが強い手掛かりです。
summary.en: Adire spans Yoruba indigo resist vocabularies; Tie-dye is strongly cued by bound radial rings and soft bursts.

decisive_cue.ja: Adireは藍染めの多様な防染語彙を確認。
decisive_cue.en: Adire spans Yoruba indigo resist vocabularies; Tie-dye is strongly cued by bound radial rings and soft bursts.

summary.ja: Sashikoは幾何学を作る規則的な運針、Kanthaは面全体のキルティング運針と自由な具象刺繍が目立ちます。
summary.en: Sashiko commonly organizes running stitches into geometry; Kantha emphasizes quilted running-stitch fields and freer imagery.

decisive_cue.ja: Sashikoは幾何学を作る規則的な運針を確認。
decisive_cue.en: Sashiko commonly organizes running stitches into geometry; Kantha emphasizes quilted running-stitch fields and freer imagery.

summary.ja: African Wax Printは高彩度で輪郭が明瞭なプリント、Batikは蝋防染由来の境界や染めの表情が手掛かりです。
summary.en: African Wax Print favors crisp saturated printed motifs; Batik is cued by wax-resist boundaries and dyed effects.

decisive_cue.ja: African Wax Printは高彩度で輪郭が明瞭なプリントを確認。
decisive_cue.en: African Wax Print favors crisp saturated printed motifs; Batik is cued by wax-resist boundaries and dyed effects.

summary.ja: Block Printは版単位の反復と位置ずれ、Kalamkariは描画的な植物・物語線が手掛かりです。
summary.en: Block Print shows modular repeated impressions; Kalamkari is more drawing-led and flowing.

decisive_cue.ja: Block Printは版単位の反復と位置ずれを確認。
decisive_cue.en: Block Print shows modular repeated impressions; Kalamkari is more drawing-led and flowing.

summary.ja: Zebraは黒白の不規則縞、Tigerは橙地に黒い先細り縞です。
summary.en: Zebra uses irregular black-white bands; Tiger uses dark tapered stripes on orange/tan.

decisive_cue.ja: Zebraは黒白の不規則縞を確認。
decisive_cue.en: Zebra uses irregular black-white bands; Tiger uses dark tapered stripes on orange/tan.

summary.ja: Snakeは細かな鱗セル、Giraffeは大きな多角形斑を淡色の網目が区切ります。
summary.en: Snake shows dense scale cells; Giraffe shows large polygonal patches separated by pale channels.

decisive_cue.ja: Snakeは細かな鱗セルを確認。
decisive_cue.en: Snake shows dense scale cells; Giraffe shows large polygonal patches separated by pale channels.

summary.ja: Cowは大きな塊状斑、Dalmatianは小〜中の孤立スポットが多数です。
summary.en: Cow uses large blob-like patches; Dalmatian uses many smaller isolated spots.

decisive_cue.ja: Cowは大きな塊状斑を確認。
decisive_cue.en: Cow uses large blob-like patches; Dalmatian uses many smaller isolated spots.

summary.ja: Tie-dyeは放射・輪・にじみを広く含み、Shiboriは日本の絞り技法としてより多様な縫い・折り・締めの痕跡を持ちます。
summary.en: Tie-dye is broadly cued by bound radial effects; Shibori covers Japanese resist methods with varied stitched, folded, and bound structures.

decisive_cue.ja: Tie-dyeは放射・輪・にじみを広く含みを確認。
decisive_cue.en: Tie-dye is broadly cued by bound radial effects; Shibori covers Japanese resist methods with varied stitched, folded, and bound structures.

summary.ja: Marblingは色筋が液体のように交差し、Moiréは平行気味の水紋・木目状バンドが続きます。
summary.en: Marbling has interwoven fluid color veins; Moiré has more parallel watered or woodgrain-like bands.

decisive_cue.ja: Marblingは色筋が液体のように交差しを確認。
decisive_cue.en: Marbling has interwoven fluid color veins; Moiré has more parallel watered or woodgrain-like bands.

summary.ja: Terrazzoは大小・多色の骨材チップ、Dalmatianは同系色の孤立スポットが中心です。
summary.en: Terrazzo uses multisize aggregate chips; Dalmatian uses mostly same-color isolated spots.

decisive_cue.ja: Terrazzoは大小・多色の骨材チップを確認。
decisive_cue.en: Terrazzo uses multisize aggregate chips; Dalmatian uses mostly same-color isolated spots.

summary.ja: Camouflageは複数色の斑が重なって輪郭を分断し、Cowは白地に単色の大きな斑が独立します。
summary.en: Camouflage overlaps several patch colors to disrupt outlines; Cow usually isolates one dark patch color on a light ground.

decisive_cue.ja: Camouflageは複数色の斑が重なって輪郭を分断しを確認。
decisive_cue.en: Camouflage overlaps several patch colors to disrupt outlines; Cow usually isolates one dark patch color on a light ground.
